mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
# pytest configuration that doubles as mutmut's project manifest.
#
# The harness's mutation_testing tool (harness/core/quality_gate/
# mutation_enforcer.py) requires a [mutmut] section in setup.cfg to run
# mutmut 2.x in its temp workdir. Without this file, mutmut generates a
# minimal config with no testpaths / no pythonpath, and the test suite
# cannot import taskq_api from the workdir.

[tool:pytest]
testpaths = tests
pythonpath = 03-development/src

[mutmut]
runner = python -m pytest
tests_dir = tests
backup = false
disable = false
paths_to_mutate = 03-development/src/taskq_api/repository,03-development/src/taskq_api/service
# service/runner.py uses Python 3.11 ``except*`` (ExceptionGroup) syntax;
# mutmut 2.x ships parso <3.11 which raises KeyError on the ``ReservedString(*)``
